title: Automatically Auditing Large Language Models via Discrete Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Using a discrete optimization algorithm (ARCA) to automatically search for prompt-output pairs that elicit toxic language, either by targeting specific pre-defined toxic strings or by optimizing an objective based on a BERT-based toxicity classifier.
Optimizing prompts to uncover factually inaccurate, derogatory, or offensive completions about specific individuals (e.g., celebrities, U.S. senators) and demographic groups.
Searching for prompts in non-English languages (e.g., French or German) that unexpectedly and unhelpfully complete to English outputs, measured using a FastText Language identification model.
